tx_household_date_idx.name: tx_household_date_idx
tx_household_date_idx.where: "transactions"."household_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."voided_at" IS NULL

tx_household_member_idx.name: tx_household_member_idx
tx_household_member_idx.where: "transactions"."household_id" IS NOT NULL AND "transactions"."voided_at" IS NULL

tx_category_rule.name: tx_category_rule
tx_category_rule.value: ("transactions"."type" = 'transfer' AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NULL) OR ("transactions"."type" <> 'transfer' AND "transactions"."category_id" IS NOT NULL)

tx_link_requires_counterparty.name: tx_link_requires_counterparty
tx_link_requires_counterparty.value: "transactions"."linked_transaction_id" IS NULL OR "transactions"."counterparty_user_id" IS NOT NULL

budget_scope_exclusive.name: budget_scope_exclusive
budget_scope_exclusive.value: ("budgets"."user_id" IS NOT NULL AND "budgets"."household_id" IS NULL AND "budgets"."category_id" IS NOT NULL AND "budgets"."category_key" IS NULL) OR ("budgets"."household_id" IS NOT NULL AND "budgets"."user_id" IS NULL AND "budgets"."category_key" IS NOT NULL AND "budgets"."category_id" IS NULL)
